short_desc: A measured value on a unit scale.
detail: A continuous measurement; unit kept in dd_data_unit.
A non-negative whole tally. Range [0,Inf] with .0 precision (integer).

short_desc: An amount per unit of exposure or time.
detail: A quantity normalized by a denominator or period.
validation: denominator & period declared ;; nonnegative where applicable

detail: Numerator over denominator; denominator nonzero.

short_desc: An elapsed amount of time as a number.
detail: A length of time as a numeric magnitude; unit in dd_data_unit.

short_desc: A score on a defined scale.
detail: Points on an instrument or test.
validation: allowed range ;; permitted increments ;; scale direction

short_desc: A constructed index relative to a base.
detail: A composite indicator with a documented base period.
Integer position within an ordering.
validation: positive integer ;; bounded by group size

detail: A monetary balance that may be negative.
Dollar money; symbol and grouping stripped to a number.
Euro money, dot-thousands / comma-decimal; symbol and grouping stripped.
A likelihood bounded to the unit interval.
Favorable:unfavorable; as_probability converts to 0-1.
A proportion on a 0-100 scale; as_percent strips a trailing %.
Rank against a reference population; strips ordinal suffixes.
Two numeric bounds in one field; split into _lo and _hi.
Reversed-order pair; as_range normalizes to _lo/_hi.
A low-high interval around an estimate, with a confidence level.
Sexagesimal pair, lat first; as_coord reprojects to WGS84 decimal degrees and splits.
Sexagesimal pair, lon first (GeoJSON order); reprojected and split.
Compact signed-decimal pair; reprojected and split.
Decimal-degree latitude (WGS84 by default).
Decimal-degree longitude (WGS84 by default).
The literal class imports raw data as text to protect original values; no formatting or cleaning, whatever the value looks like.
A brief descriptive label (not a controlled category).
A work or section title.
Multi-sentence notes or descriptions.
validation: preserve line breaks ;; flag control characters

detail: Structured data carried as a string; promote to structured if parsed.
An individual's name; format notes the ordering convention.
A legal or organization name.
A named place as free text (a geographic code is categorical.geographic).
An account handle; promote to identifier when it keys the account. Platform in the token; @ stripped, lowercased.
The street line of a physical address.
A post-office box address.
A complete one-line mailing address.
A web address; as_url adds scheme, lowercases host, normalizes www, drops trailing slash.
A bare host name without scheme or path.
An IPv4 or IPv6 network address.
A hardware MAC address.
An RFC-style email address; as_email lowercases the domain.
A telephone number; as_phone normalizes to E.164.
A #RRGGBB color; as_hex adds # and uppercases.
Red-green-blue channels 0-255.
Hue-saturation-lightness.
Cyan-magenta-yellow-key 0-1.
Levels with no meaningful order; labels held in dd_f_levels.
Order carried by the order field in dd_f_levels.
A geography used as a grouping variable; format defers to geographic tokens. Promoted to identifier.id.geographic when near-unique.
A code from a standard classification (NAICS, ICD); format = class:<system>.
Categories explaining why a value is missing; kept separate from substantive values.
validation: mutually exclusive ;; separate from substantive values

short_desc: Zero or more levels per record.
detail: A delimited set of members; member encoding plus [delim:x].
validation: allowed member values ;; no duplicate members

detail: Symmetric agree-disagree scale; code split from label into dd_f_levels with order.
A bounded rating (stars, 1-10).
An ordering of choices by preference.
validation: unique ranks where required ;; bounded by option count

detail: School grade (K-12); ordered with roughly interval spacing.
A dummy variable marking presence of a condition.
validation: exactly two states ;; distinguish missing from false

detail: A checkbox where a mark is TRUE and blank is FALSE.
A two-state status via an explicit token set.
A binary survey answer; refusal/missing kept separate.
Multiple encodings in one column; presets unioned with | and blank=false.
A day-resolution date; stabilized to ISO yyyymmdd. Raw order/separator recorded in data_format.
validation: valid calendar date ;; no impossible dates

short_desc: A date plus time of day.
detail: A timestamp resolving to a moment.
A clock time with no calendar date.
A calendar or fiscal year.
A calendar or fiscal quarter.
A year-month period; drives the monthly calendar graphic.
A fiscal or reporting window; split into _start and _end.
Recurring hour position 0-23.
Stabilized to numeric 1-7 (week-start declared); name label in dd_f_levels. Drives the day-of-week graphic.
Stabilized to numeric 1-12 (Jan-Dec); name label in dd_f_levels. Not tied to a year.
Recurring ISO/US week number 1-53.
A start and end calendar date; split into _start and _end.
A per-row primary key (serial, UUID, slug).
Names a real-world entity (accession, ORG-001, gene/protein IDs).
validation: unique within entity domain ;; stable over time

detail: A government/registry ID; as_ein restores the dropped leading zero and delimiter (the hyphen hardens it).
validation: domain pattern ;; checksum where available ;; preserve leading zeros

detail: An all-numeric geo code: as_id zero-pads AND prefixes (FIPS-) so it stays character everywhere; prefix also disambiguates 5-digit FIPS from CBSA. dd_is_join_key=TRUE by default.
validation: fixed length ;; preserve leading zeros ;; valid vintage

detail: A content hash used as an identifier (MD5, SHA-256, UUID).
A version or revision tag (semver-style).
validation: valid version syntax ;; monotonicity where expected

detail: A variable-length collection carried in one cell.
A fixed-shape multi-dimensional collection.
A schema-bearing record of named fields.
A dictionary; [delim:x] separates pairs, [kv:x] splits key from value.
A spatial point; CRS declared.
A spatial polygon; CRS declared.
validation: valid geometry ;; ring closure ;; CRS declared

detail: Multiple value types share one column; retained as text, dominant type flagged for review.
Values that failed to parse; retained verbatim (literal) for review.
validation: retain source text ;; log parse errors

detail: No confident type; retained as text and profiled.
validation: retain original values ;; do not coerce
